responsibilities: Design and maintain a robust data foundation that supports Manufacturing and Engineering.
Create and manage data products that improve access to reliable, high-quality data.
Transform data into scalable solutions that enable informed business decisions.
Support the development of automated data pipelines, APIs, and analytics capabilities.
Contribute to data engineering standards and ways of working across the organisation.
Help teams understand performance metrics and identify opportunities for improvement through data.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Create and manage data products that improve access to reliable, high-quality data.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Reliability, trust and quality recur across the summary, bullets and success criteria ("reliable, high-quality data", "trusted data") with no speed language, so rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: enables Manufacturing and Engineering teams to make better decisions through data
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Errors would affect manufacturing and engineering decisions, not financial reporting or regulated outputs, so moderate.
evidence.collaboration_width: Manufacturing; Engineering; product managers; project managers
evidence.data_team_maturity: You'll join the Data Engineering & Analytics team within Engineering & Workplace in Operations
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The team sits inside named nested units ("Manufacturing Products and Data Enablement", "Engineering & Workplace in Operations") with sites in Billund and Nyíregyháza, an established specialised data organisation.
evidence.jd_authorship: Design and maintain a robust data foundation that supports Manufacturing and Engineering... Transform data into scalable solutions that enable informed business decisions.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Some lines are specific to manufacturing data products, Databricks and dimensional models, but several bullets are generic ("Transform data into scalable solutions"), so mixed.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: build a reliable data foundation that enables Manufacturing and Engineering teams to make better decisions through data
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role builds the data foundation and data products other teams consume, an internal-data orientation serving operations rather than commercial, product or finance users.
evidence.autonomy_level: Support the development of automated data pipelines, APIs, and analytics capabilities.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Verbs are support, contribute and help, with design-and-maintain ownership limited to the technical foundation, so execution.
evidence.ai_role: Applied agentic data engineering concepts in data platform environments.

evidence.testing_framing: improve the availability and quality of data

evidence.loss_aversion_framing: deliver solutions that people use and trust
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Trust is the primary framing in the role summary and repeats in the bullets and success criteria ("reliable data products that stakeholders trust"), so high.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Design and maintain a robust data foundation
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role builds new data products for an expanding manufacturing footprint while maintaining the existing foundation, so mixed.
evidence.urgency: Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

evidence.loss_aversion: Success means delivering reliable data products that stakeholders trust and use. — trust in data is the role's measure of success.
